description: Clean code quality gate — diff-scoped blocking review on session stop, type-safety grep on every edit

hooks.prompt:
Run `git diff` (uncommitted, working tree only) once. If empty, respond exactly: No issues. Otherwise scan ONLY that diff for blocking violations and respond with one short line per finding (file:line + category + 1-clause reason). No preamble, no session re-read, no exploration beyond the diff. Use the cleanup and dependencies skills as reference for the categories below.

Categories:
- AGENT-SLOP: new files that route around a problem instead of fixing it (adapters, compatibility layers, wrappers, normalizers, bridges, re-export barrels); banned suffixes (DTO/Response/Manager/Helper/Utils/Mapper/Adapter/Bridge/Wrapper).
- TYPE-SAFETY: unsafe casts, raw/unparameterized types, stringly-typed containers (Map<String,Object>/JsonNode/Object), suppressed warnings, downstream re-parsing/re-validation of an already-canonical payload.
- CANONICAL-DATA: a new type duplicating fields of an existing canonical owner; shadow owners; anemic wrappers; Ref/Brief/Detail tiers repeating fields.
- FRAMEWORK-FIRST / DEP-DUP: hand-written logic a framework, SDK, stdlib, or project dependency already provides — verify via the dependencies skill before flagging.
- ALGORITHM: N+1 in loops, O(n) where O(1) is trivial, unbatched sequential I/O.
- ROOT-CAUSE: fallbacks masking errors, swallowed causes, workarounds instead of fixing the producer.
- SIMPLIFICATION: verbose names, overlapping types that should merge, derivable state passed as params.
- ARCHITECTURE: thick controllers, business logic in adapters, non-deterministic test fixtures.

Carve-outs — do NOT flag:
- Exception-unwrapping helpers that re-throw Error while returning converted exceptions are idiomatic.
- Exception-catch breadth: catching a SPECIFIC exception (e.g. DataAccessException, JacksonException) instead of RuntimeException/Exception/Throwable is CORRECT and is REQUIRED by deterministic static-analysis gates (e.g. Detekt TooGenericExceptionCaught), which FAIL the build on broad catches unless the file is in the gate's curated excludes. Never recommend widening a catch or suppressing a gate rule; defer to the static-analysis gate on anything it already governs (catch breadth, lint/suppression rules).

Report blocking only. Be ruthlessly terse.

Disposition tags: end every finding line with `FIX NOW` (canonical owner inside the working scope), `FILE ISSUE` (owner elsewhere), or `FOREIGN?` (the hunk may be a concurrent session's uncommitted work — the diff alone cannot prove authorship). If any finding exists, end the report with exactly: `DISPOSITION REQUIRED: reclassify any finding on a hunk you did not author as FOREIGN and leave that hunk untouched per git-safety, naming it in your report; fix each FIX NOW finding at its canonical owner; file one deduped gh issue per FILE ISSUE finding (gh-issues skill: search open issues first) — findings answered with prose are the failure this gate exists to stop.`
